note: Keyword bank for Pinterest. `variants` are what the pin-writer A/B tests: one pin per variant, each with its own utm_content, so outbound clicks tell us which phrasing wins. Status moves untested -> testing -> winner|retired. Never delete a retired term; move it to `retired` so we do not re-test a settled question. Board names must match the live Pinterest boards exactly.
rules: Never use 'Hull Creek' as a keyword or in a pin title. Locked in CLAUDE.md, and nobody searches it.
Lead with recognizable geography: Virginia's Northern Neck, Chesapeake Bay, or the DC drive market.
Titles are search queries, not headlines. First ~40 characters carry the load.

boards.name: Virginia's Northern Neck
supporting: Northern Neck Virginia things to do
boards.sourceNote: Geography term with real search volume and low competition. The place name is the whole point: it is what someone types when they have heard of the region but not decided anything.

boards.name: Weekend Getaways from Washington DC
boards.sourceNote: Highest-intent board we have. Pinterest travel behavior in 2026 skews to weekend itineraries and trips without heavy logistics, which is exactly this.

boards.name: Chesapeake Bay Travel
boards.sourceNote: Broader than the Northern Neck and catches people who know the bay but not the peninsula.

boards.name: Waterfront Cottage Stays
supporting: cabin with hot tub and sauna
boards.sourceNote: Stay-type board. Catches people shopping for a kind of place rather than a destination, which is a different and often earlier moment.

boards.name: Slow Weekends and Cabin Trips
boards.sourceNote: Wellness and nature-stay framing is called out in the 2026 travel trend reporting. This is the board where the journal's register works as-is.

variants: Weekend Getaways from Washington DC: Virginia's Northern Neck
Weekend Trips from DC Without Bay Bridge Traffic
Where to Go Instead of the Eastern Shore: A DC Weekend
weekend-getaways-from-washington-dc.rationale: Three distinct intents: destination discovery, the traffic pain point, and comparison shopping against a known alternative.

variants: A Long Weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: 3-Day Itinerary
Waterfront Long Weekend 2.5 Hours from Washington DC
Crab Pull, Kayaks, Sauna: A Chesapeake Weekend Itinerary
northern-neck-long-weekend-from-dc.rationale: Itinerary posts are one of the strongest travel formats on Pinterest. Variant 3 tests concrete activities over the itinerary frame.

variants: How to Actually Disconnect on a Weekend Away
The Slow Weekend: An Unplugged Trip That Works
Digital Detox Weekend: A Waterfront Field Guide
the-art-of-the-slow-weekend.rationale: Not a destination post, so it competes on the behavior rather than the place. Strongest fit for the slow-travel board.

variants: Reedville, Virginia: A Working Fishing Village Guide
Things to Do in Reedville on Virginia's Northern Neck
The Chesapeake Town Built on Menhaden, Not Tourism
complete-guide-to-reedville-virginia.rationale: Place-name search, things-to-do search, and a curiosity hook. Variant 3 is the test of whether story framing pulls at all.

variants: 24 Hours in Irvington, Virginia: A Day Trip Guide
Irvington VA: Tides Inn, Farmers Market, and the Vineyard
The Prettiest Small Town on Virginia's Northern Neck
24-hours-in-irvington-virginia.rationale: Day-trip framing, named-landmark framing, and superlative framing. The third is the riskiest and worth a clean read.

variants: Crabbing on the Chesapeake: A Morning on the Dock
How to Pull a Crab Pot at First Light
Blue Crab Season in Virginia: What a Morning Looks Like
crabbers-morning-on-hull-creek.rationale: Activity search, how-to search, and season search. No 'Hull Creek' in any title, per the locked rule.

variants: Osprey Season on the Chesapeake: A Dock at Dawn
Birding Virginia's Northern Neck: Osprey, Heron, Eagle
What a Morning on a Tidal Creek Sounds Like
mornings-with-the-ospreys-hull-creek.rationale: Birding is a real Pinterest niche with a devoted audience. Variant 3 tests atmosphere against the birding-list framing.

variants: Cedar Sauna and Cold Creek: The Ritual, Done Right
Cabin with a Sauna and Cold Plunge in Virginia
Nordic Sauna Ritual on a Chesapeake Creek
cottage-sauna-culture.rationale: Sauna and cold plunge is a strong, growing search. Variant 2 is the stay-shopping version and should be watched closely, since it is closest to booking intent.

variants: Easy Vacation House Dinners: Low Boil, Burgers, Caprese
What to Cook at a Waterfront Rental
Country Low Boil: The One-Pot Vacation Dinner
waterfront-kitchen-family-recipes.rationale: Food guides travel well on Pinterest and this is the only food post we have. Variant 3 is a single-recipe hook and may outperform the roundups.
